'implementation-detail/phase-4/experiments/g3-incremental-materialization/G3-POST-SEAL-DOCUMENTATION-ADDENDUM-v1.md']
expected={
docs[0]:'3b202bb1174a1ce2e34b0559d1da828a762ef0e25f3beaaeedd556427fa94aee',
docs[1]:'dfa2843ea1874a99df762dd07180672c43a537d0be9b69f43789a5ee521569d3a',

def h(path):
 d=hashlib.sha256()
 with path.open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''): d.update(b)
 return d.hexdigest()
def ch(value): return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','branch','--show-current'],text=True).strip()=='codex/empty-worktree'
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip()=='d79f0e0e2582d1bc491410224fec2b6cef7482e9'
rows=[]
texts={}
for name in docs:
 p=r/name; data=p.read_bytes(); text=data.decode(); texts[name]=text
 assert h(p)==expected[name] and (p.stat().st_mode&0o7777)==0o644 and data.endswith(b'\n') and b'\r' not in data
 assert all(line==line.rstrip(' \t') for line in text.splitlines())
 rows.append({'path':name,'sha256':h(p),'size_bytes':p.stat().st_size,'mode':'0644'})
active=rows[:4]
assert ch(active)=='f56faaadc46d4bfd4e4db749085ac2e45ac649d8775c066cc791f33f922df8c9'
report=texts[docs[0]]; baseline=texts[docs[1]]; index=texts[docs[2]]; roadmap=texts[docs[3]]; addendum=texts[docs[4]]
assert 'G3 PASS / G4 READY — v11 STATICALLY CLOSED AND TERMINALLY SEALED' in report
assert 'G3 PASS / SEALED — G4 READY AND UNSTARTED' in baseline
assert 'Current sealed G3 mechanism baseline' in index
assert 'G3  incremental prototype              PASS      sealed v11' in roadmap

assert 'This documentation closure records **G3 PASS / G4 READY**' in addendum
stale=['STATIC CLOSURE AND TERMINAL SEAL PENDING','seal pending','must still be completed before','do not exist. The required static closure','before claiming terminal G3 PASS']

assert all(h(sealed/name)==digest for name,digest in sealed_hashes.items())
terminal=json.loads((sealed/'TERMINAL-v11.json').read_text()); verification=json.loads((sealed/'TERMINAL-VERIFICATION-v11.txt').read_text())
assert terminal['status']=='PASS' and terminal['disposition']=='G3 PASS / G4 READY' and terminal['g4_eligible'] is True and terminal['payload_manifest_entries']==66
assert verification['status']=='PASS' and verification['manifest_closure_exact'] is True and verification['payload_mismatches']==0
manifest=list(csv.DictReader((sealed/'PAYLOAD-MANIFEST-v11.tsv').open(),delimiter='\t'))
assert len(manifest)==66
manifest_paths={row['path'] for row in manifest}
for row in manifest:
 p=sealed/row['path']; assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink() and h(p)==row['sha256'] and p.stat().st_size==int(row['size_bytes'])
actual={str(p.relative_to(sealed)) for p in sealed.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and p.name not in {'PAYLOAD-MANIFEST-v11.tsv','TERMINAL-v11.json','TERMINAL-VERIFICATION-v11.txt'}}
assert actual==manifest_paths
files=[p for p in sealed.rglob('*') if p.is_file()]; directories=[sealed.parent,sealed,*[p for p in sealed.rglob('*') if p.is_dir()]]
assert len(files)==69 and all((p.stat().st_mode&0o7777)==0o444 for p in files)
assert len(directories)==14 and all((p.stat().st_mode&0o7777)==0o555 for p in directories)
assert not any(p.is_symlink() for p in sealed.parent.rglob('*'))
assert not (r/'target/phase4-g3-incremental-materialization-20260822-v11.lock').exists() and not (sealed/'FAILURE-v11.json').exists()
workspace=(sealed/'static-v11/02-workspace-tests.stdout').read_text()
counts=[tuple(map(int,m)) for m in re.findall(r'test result: ok\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored; (\d+) measured;',workspace)]
assert tuple(sum(x[i] for x in counts) for i in range(4))==(151,0,1,0)
allowed={'G3-POST-SEAL-DOCUMENTATION-CLOSURE-v1.json','G3-POST-SEAL-DOCUMENTATION-VERIFICATION-v1.txt'}
links=0; broken=[]; planned=[]
for name,text in texts.items():
 parent=(r/name).parent
 for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)',text):
  if target.startswith(('http://','https://','mailto:','#')): continue
  links+=1; clean=target.strip('<>').split('#',1)[0]; resolved=(parent/clean).resolve()
  if resolved.exists(): continue
  if Path(clean).name in allowed: planned.append(Path(clean).name); continue
  broken.append({'document':name,'target':target})
assert links==44 and not broken and sorted(planned)==sorted(allowed)
status=subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--short'],text=True)
root_rows=[{'path':str(p.relative_to(sealed.parent)),'sha256':h(p),'size_bytes':p.stat().st_size,'mode':f'{p.stat().st_mode&0o7777:04o}'} for p in sorted(files)]
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASS','docs':rows,'active_docs_set_sha256':ch(active),'docs_set_sha256':ch(rows),'links_checked':links,'broken_links':0,'planned_forward_links':sorted(planned),'stale_preseal_claims':0,'workspace_tests':{'passed':151,'ignored':1,'failed':0},'sealed_hashes':sealed_hashes,'manifest_entries':66,'sealed_root':{'files_0444':69,'directories_0555':14,'symlinks':0,'lock_absent':True,'failure_absent':True,'fingerprint_sha256':ch(root_rows)},'stage':{'g3':'PASS_SEALED','g4':'READY_UNSTARTED','g5':'PENDING','g6':'PENDING','phase4_complete':False,'production_integrated':False},'git_status_lines':len(status.splitlines()),'git_status_sha256':hashlib.sha256(status.encode()).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':')))
